composition: Cylindrical White Tower on the Thermaic Gulf promenade · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Nikis Avenue waterfront, the cylindrical white tower stands at the edge of the gulf, crenellated, with the smaller turret on top. The promenade lamps curve beside it under a clear sky, about 15.1°C. Architectural light picks out the cylinder. That lighting is the Ministry of Culture night-lighting project reported in 2026; a shutoff hour was not published.
